No suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, or dangerous commands (eval, base64, curl|bash) are present. The checksum is pinned (not SKIP), providing integrity verification. The use of a CI run ID as pkgver is unconventional but not malicious — it pins the specific artifact downloaded.
